title: OpenEval: Benchmarking Chinese LLMs across Capability, Alignment and Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice questions computing a Bias Score based on hypotheses derived from contextual information using the CBBQ (Chinese Bias Benchmark) dataset.
Prompting models to identify and classify biased attitudes (e.g., anti-bias, neutral, biased) in conversational interactions using the CDIAL-BIAS dataset.

Classifying specific types of sexism (e.g., appearance-based stereotypes, cultural context-based stereotypes, microaggressions, and aggression) in social media posts using the SWSR dataset, as well as probing for gender bias using the CORGI-PM corpus.
